opening.argument: The video explains slippage through a concrete croissant-price example and an on-screen PancakeSwap demonstration. It shows how the executed price can exceed the intended price, then presents higher tolerance as a tradeoff: an order may execute more quickly, but the buyer may pay more. The speaker recommends a compromise between speed and value, not a profit outcome or a transfer of money or personal data. The description includes an exchange referral promotion, but the supplied content does not establish deceptive claims or harmful destination behavior.
